facts.description: Gemini Robotics ER 1.6 is a vision-language model (VLM) that brings Gemini's agentic capabilities to robotics. It's designed for advanced reasoning in the physical world, allowing robots to interpret complex visual data, perform spatial reasoning, and plan actions from natural language commands.
